purpose: Independent first-order oracle math showing the uncertainty omitted by conditioning a learned continuous frequency as fixed. This does not implement or score an estimator.
model: Eight independent past source frames with per-frame/RGB nuisance intercept and physical cos/sin coefficients, shared continuous frequencies. Known IID per-RGB sigma, known true frequencies/amplitudes only for Jacobian evaluation. A fresh current frame has independent noise; the learned past-frequency covariance propagates through current conditional coefficient refitting.
checks: Analytic centered-basis Jacobian against finite differences
Schur frequency information against joint inverse Fisher
Conditional complex q envelope against real2D coefficient covariance
Frequency covariance propagated after current coefficient refit
limitations: Local linear Gaussian oracle, no global nonlinear coverage
No random selection/multiple proposal or correlated covariance model
No frequency estimate, prototype input, truth quality score, native job or game conclusion
First-order information is singular for exact real Nyquist cases; do not invert or infer zero uncertainty
This math is distinct from actual selected-model error; frozen design remains unchanged
